data.name: EditsRefusal
data.value: The connection is read-only: nothing is written to it, and editing records does not apply. Nothing was sent to the database.

data.name: WithoutAReadMessage
data.value: the statement does not start with SELECT, WITH or VALUES

data.name: IntoMessage
data.value: SELECT ... INTO writes the result to a table

data.name: LockMessage
data.value: the row lock (FOR UPDATE, FOR SHARE) is for changing the rows

data.name: SequenceMessage
data.value: advancing a sequence (NEXT VALUE FOR, NEXTVAL) cannot be undone

data.name: Db2TableFunctionMessage
data.value: in Db2, a table function (TABLE (...)) can write without the statement showing it

data.name: Db2ExplainMessage
data.value: in Db2, EXPLAIN writes to the explain tables

data.name: SeveralStatementsMessage
data.value: the text has more than one statement
